name: Unknown
source: The man who asked [url=/c96494]Jean DuPont[/url] to steal the holy sword Elzesphere. This mysterious person hides his face behind a mask, so that his identity remains unknown. He possesses a magic sword that should have been lost and seems to be a military official from the Erectus army.
